description: TIREK mentions residents protesting a mine on Dec 6, but available partial text has no attendance or clear demand/target details; do not borrow May or Nov counts/details.
Captured reporting describes an official wreath ceremony, leaflets at unknown time and pre-event arrests, but no separately established protest gathering or crowd.
Open-web searches are non-exhaustive; official baseline and historical originals unavailable in this workspace. A reported refusal of a time-zone protest is not a held event.
